description: Post-Unified Reasoning Milestone blind benchmark. Evaluates Simplicial Type Theory integration and unified shared-service consistency across battery, polymer, metal, ceramic, and cross-domain families. Targets recent 2024-2026 literature findings and complex interface cases.
selection_policy: Forty source-backed pairs selected from 2024-2026 research papers, SCHOTT/MO-SCI technical datasheets, and established materials handbooks. Balance maintained between positive (standard/novel compatible) and negative (mismatch/corrosion/oxidation) controls.
holdout_policy: Frozen on 2026-05-27. No tuning allowed against this file until Q8 results are reported. Treat as blind validation.
